models_evaluated: IGUANA (Interpretable Gland-Graphs using a Neural Aggregator)

links.outcome: Clinical impact of AI false-negative errors on patients, as scored by expert pathological and clinical review
links.effect: 220 FN errors across 164 cases (4.4% of WSI, 7.9% of cases); 88.4% of FN errors would have no impact on patient care, with only one error causing major patient harm.
links.quote: 88.4% of FN errors would have no impact on patient care, with only one error causing major patient harm.

unlisted_practices: Clinical-context review of AI error types and downstream patient impact to inform adoption decisions for autonomous reporting of normal cases

screen.reason: Retrospective clinical and pathological failure analysis / error audit of a digital pathology screening AI tool to determine the clinical risk of false negatives.
